requested_changes.body: These output files don't need to be committed.

It's good to test from a pdf file but this doesn't need to go under unit tests. Unit tests need to be more compact. You can simply write a test which shows passing `llm_context` from a string in same file. Another to not passing. Another to passing but not really a context, and so on.
Also, the test file name doesn't have to be CAPS. Please check out how the rest of the files are written and follow similar naming convention.
